title: Worldpay — data notes
audience: Dashboard Builder Chat. Card-present processor auths. Not Genius POS sales. Not Olo Pay / Stripe. Not settlement / 11th Column.

joins: GOLD_SEMANTIC.SALES.VW_DIM_STORE_CURATED on NEWCOID = DB_NEWCOID AND OWNERSHIP = 'Company Owned'. Inner join — Franchised and unmapped shops are excluded.
source.shop_list: GOLD_SEMANTIC.SALES.VW_DIM_STORE_CURATED.OWNERSHIP = Company Owned. Same Gold dim as Genius/Olo. No Excel mapping. Chain 0OS957 vs CO was previously unconfirmed; this table’s DB_NEWCOID rows in recent weeks all resolve to Company Owned.
source.txn_filter: TRANS_TYPE = IP (purchase auth). IX and IS rows are excluded.

time.date_field: TRANS_DATE (cast to DATE). Processor trans date, not Genius business date.

files.weekly_data: worldpay_data_YYYYMMDD.json — YYYYMMDD is the Monday week start. One week per file.
files.methodology: worldpay_methodology.json — rewrite only when definitions change (--write-methodology).

kpi_definitions.SALES_VOLUME: Approved IP auth dollars (AUTH_AMOUNT / 100) at Company Owned shops. Includes tip. What Worldpay authorized, not Genius drink sales.
kpi_definitions.TRANSACTION_COUNT: Count of those approved IP rows after SYS_HASH dedupe.
kpi_definitions.AVG_TICKET: SALES_VOLUME ÷ TRANSACTION_COUNT. Per auth, not per Genius order.
kpi_definitions.AUTHORIZATION_RATE: Approved IP (AUTH_REQUEST_RESP_CODE = AA) ÷ all IP attempts × 100.
kpi_definitions.CARD_BRAND_MIX: CARD_TYPE on approved IPs: Visa, Mastercard (MCRD), Amex, Discover (DISC).

not_in_this_extract: Tip split (Worldpay auth is billed total)
Refunds / voids as a separate volume (not on IP)
do_not: Add Worldpay SALES_VOLUME to Genius Card — overlapping window cards, different grain (auth+tip vs POS ex-tip).
Add Worldpay to Olo Pay — different processor and channel.
Treat AVG_TICKET as Genius average ticket.
